articles.summary: GREENVILLE, S.C., March 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- United Community Banks, Inc. (NYSE: UCB) announces it will release its first quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, April 21, 2026, before the stock market opens. The company also will hold a conference call at 9:00 a.m.
articles.title: United Community Banks, Inc. Announces Date for First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
